instruction: Download receipts of all my amazon orders in "~/bills/amazon_purchases/" folder in my file system. Name the files in the format, "yyyy-mm-dd__<order_id>.txt". Replace <order_id> with the actual order id, and yyyy-mm-dd with the date when the order was placed. You should be able to find receipts from order confirmation emails.

target_dir = '~/bills/amazon_purchases/'

else:
    print('no existing directory; will create')

# Fetch all amazon orders with pagination
amazon_token = amazon_token  # from earlier block

orders = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

while True:
    res = apis.amazon.show_orders(access_token=amazon_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'res:', res)
    if isinstance(res, dict) and 'message' in res:
        # failure
        raise Exception(res['message'])
    if not res:
        break
    orders.extend(res)
    if len(res) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_orders:', len(orders))
